claims.statement: The Commission reports 2.11 million European heat-pump installations in 2024 and identifies installer shortages as a barrier.
EU guidance recognizes continuous electronic monitoring as a possible alternative to some building-system inspections.

contrary_evidence: Manufacturers increasingly bundle proprietary remote diagnostics.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: wholesalers and the family installer network.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 30000 units at 25 PLN monthly yield 9 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN in five to seven years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15 hours weekly with contracted HVAC review.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 75% after telemetry and exception review.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: six months for a 200-unit fleet.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15-40 PLN per unit monthly plus 300-800 PLN per commissioning report.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: monitoring, seasonal faults, and warranty evidence retain units for years.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Every confirmed repair expands device-specific fault coverage
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Fleet diagnostics sold per unit and report
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The installer pays on unit activation or report request
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A commissioned or operating unit underperforms without an obvious cause

founder_fit: Sensor analytics and direct installer access fit a narrow part-time launch.
risks: Unsafe recommendations could damage equipment or people.

structure.control_point: Cross-brand telemetry signatures linked to confirmed faults and repair outcomes
structure.critical_dependency: Stable controller integrations and lawful customer telemetry access

thesis: Hardware-agnostic heat-pump commissioning and fault diagnostics for installer fleets accumulate cross-brand labeled fault signatures and verified fixes.
title: HeatTrace Fleet
uncertainties: Cross-brand access and attainable alert precision are unvalidated.
